```{r functions-core, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================================
# FUNCTIONS - Core Data Loading
# ============================================================================

#' Load race configuration XML
#' @param path Path to config.xml
#' @return Parsed XML document
load_config <- function(path = CONFIG_FILE) {
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
        stop("Config file not found: ", path)
    }
    read_xml(path)
}

#' Load race results JSON
#' @param path Path to boats_result.json
#' @return List with results
load_results <- function(path = RESULTS_FILE) {
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
        stop("Results file not found: ", path)
    }
    fromJSON(path)
}

#' Load boat info JSON (or extract from config)
#' @param path Path to boatinfo.json
#' @param config_xml Optional config XML to extract from
#' @return List with boat information
load_boat_info <- function(path = BOATINFO_FILE, config_xml = NULL) {
    if (file.exists(path)) {
        fromJSON(path)
    } else if (!is.null(config_xml)) {
        extract_boats_from_config(config_xml)
    } else {
        stop("No boat info source available")
    }
}

#' Extract boat information from config XML
#' @param config_xml Parsed XML document
#' @return List indexed by boat ID
extract_boats_from_config <- function(config_xml) {
    boat_classes <- xml_find_all(config_xml, ".//boats/boat-class")
    
    boat_info <- list()
    
    for (bc in boat_classes) {
        category <- xml_attr(bc, "name")
        boats <- xml_find_all(bc, ".//boat")
        
        for (boat in boats) {
            boat_id <- as.integer(xml_attr(boat, "id"))
            boat_name <- xml_attr(boat, "name")
            
            navigators <- xml_find_all(boat, ".//crew/navigator")
            skippers <- sapply(navigators, function(nav) {
                paste(xml_attr(nav, "fname"), xml_attr(nav, "lname"), sep = "_")
            })
            
            boat_info[[as.character(boat_id)]] <- list(
                boatName = boat_name,
                skipperNames = paste(skippers, collapse = "_&_"),
                category = category
            )
        }
    }
    return(boat_info)
}

#' Extract race metadata
#' @param config_xml Parsed XML
#' @return List with metadata
extract_metadata <- function(config_xml) {
    config <- xml_find_first(config_xml, ".//config")
    
    list(
        name = xml_attr(config, "name"),
        category = xml_attr(config, "category"),
        state = xml_attr(config, "state"),
        date = xml_attr(config, "date"),
        leg_start = xml_attr(xml_find_first(config, ".//leg"), "start"),
        leg_arrival = xml_attr(xml_find_first(config, ".//leg"), "arrival"),
        leg_num = as.integer(xml_attr(xml_find_first(config, ".//leg"), "num"))
    )
}

#' Extract route waypoints
#' @param config_xml Parsed XML
#' @return List of route segments
extract_routes <- function(config_xml) {
    routes <- xml_find_all(config_xml, ".//leg/route")
    
    route_list <- lapply(routes, function(r) {
        route_text <- xml_text(r)
        waypoints <- strsplit(route_text, ";")[[1]]
        
        wp_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(waypoints, function(wp) {
            coords <- strsplit(wp, ",")[[1]]
            data.frame(lat = as.numeric(coords[1]), lon = as.numeric(coords[2]))
        }))
        
        wp_df$order <- seq_len(nrow(wp_df))
        list(id = xml_attr(r, "id"), waypoints = wp_df)
    })
    
    return(route_list)
}
```

```{r functions-track, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================================
# FUNCTIONS - Track Analysis (Maneuvers, Polars)
# ============================================================================

#' Calculate heading between two points
#' @param lat1, lon1 Point 1
#' @param lat2, lon2 Point 2
#' @return Heading in degrees (0-360)
calculate_heading <- function(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
    lat1 <- lat1 * pi / 180
    lat2 <- lat2 * pi / 180
    dlon <- (lon2 - lon1) * pi / 180
    
    y <- sin(dlon) * cos(lat2)
    x <- cos(lat1) * sin(lat2) - sin(lat1) * cos(lat2) * cos(dlon)
    
    heading <- atan2(y, x) * 180 / pi
    heading %% 360
}

#' Count maneuvers from track
#' @param track Matrix/dataframe with lat, lon columns
#' @param threshold Angle threshold in degrees
#' @return List with maneuver counts and details
analyze_maneuvers <- function(track, threshold = MANEUVER_ANGLE_THRESHOLD) {
    if (is.null(track) || nrow(track) < 3) {
        return(list(
            total_maneuvers = 0,
            tacks = 0,
            gybes = 0,
            maneuvers_detail = data.frame()
        ))
    }
    
    # Sample track for performance
    n_points <- min(nrow(track), TRACK_SAMPLE_RATE * 10)
    idx <- seq(1, nrow(track), length.out = n_points)
    track <- track[idx, ]
    
    # Calculate headings
    headings <- sapply(2:nrow(track), function(i) {
        calculate_heading(track[i-1, 1], track[i-1, 2], track[i, 1], track[i, 2])
    })
    
    # Calculate heading changes
    heading_changes <- diff(headings)
    heading_changes <- ifelse(heading_changes > 180, heading_changes - 360, heading_changes)
    heading_changes <- ifelse(heading_changes < -180, heading_changes + 360, heading_changes)
    
    # Identify maneuvers
    abs_changes <- abs(heading_changes)
    maneuver_idx <- which(abs_changes >= threshold)
    
    # Classify: tacks (upwind, >45 left) vs gybes (downwind, >45 right)
    tacks <- sum(heading_changes[maneuver_idx] < -threshold & abs_changes[maneuver_idx] > 45)
    gybes <- sum(heading_changes[maneuver_idx] > threshold & abs_changes[maneuver_idx] > 45)
    
    list(
        total_maneuvers = length(maneuver_idx),
        tacks = tacks,
        gybes = gybes,
        heading_changes = heading_changes,
        maneuver_indices = maneuver_idx
    ))
}

#' Estimate polar from track data
#' @param track GPS track matrix
#' @param wind_direction Approximate wind direction (degrees)
#' @param sample_size Number of points to analyze
#' @return Data frame with estimated polar
estimate_polar <- function(track, wind_direction = NULL, sample_size = 500) {
    if (is.null(track) || nrow(track) < 50) {
        return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Sample track
    n <- min(nrow(track), sample_size)
    idx <- seq(1, nrow(track), length.out = n)
    track <- track[idx, ]
    
    # Calculate speeds and headings
    speeds <- c()
    twa <- c()
    
    for (i in 2:(nrow(track) - 1)) {
        dist <- geodist::geodist(
            c(track[i-1, 1], track[i, 1]),
            c(track[i-1, 2], track[i, 2]),
            pairwise = TRUE
        ) * 0.539957  # km to nm
        
        time_diff <- 1  # assume 1 hour between points
        speed <- dist / time_diff
        
        if (speed > 2 && speed < 25) {  # reasonable speed range
            heading <- calculate_heading(track[i-1, 1], track[i-1, 2], track[i, 1], track[i, 2])
            
            if (!is.null(wind_direction)) {
                twa_angle <- abs(heading - wind_direction)
                twa_angle <- min(twa_angle, 360 - twa_angle)
            } else {
                twa_angle <- NA
            }
            
            speeds <- c(speeds, speed)
            twa <- c(twa, twa_angle)
        }
    }
    
    if (length(speeds) < 10) {
        return(NULL)
    }
    
    data.frame(
        speed_knots = speeds,
        twa = twa,
        heading = NA
    )
}

#' Calculate polar efficiency
#' @param actual_polar Data frame from estimate_polar
#' @param theoretical_polar Reference polar data (optional)
#' @param wind_direction Wind direction
#' @return Efficiency percentage
calculate_polar_efficiency <- function(actual_polar, theoretical_polar = NULL, wind_direction) {
    if (is.null(actual_polar) || nrow(actual_polar) < 10) {
        return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Calculate TWA angles
    twa_bins <- cut(actual_polar$twa, breaks = c(0, 30, 45, 60, 90, 110, 135, 180),
                 labels = c("0-30", "30-45", "45-60", "60-90", "90-110", "110-135", "135-180"))
    
    efficiency <- actual_polar %>%
        mutate(twa_bin = twa_bins) %>%
        group_by(twa_bin) %>%
        summarise(
            avg_speed = mean(speed_knots),
            max_speed = max(speed_knots),
            n_points = n(),
            .groups = "drop"
        )
    
    return(efficiency)
}

#' Calculate VMG (Velocity Made Good) to a target
#' @param track GPS track
#' @param target_lat, target_lon Target coordinates
#' @return VMG in knots
calculate_vmg <- function(track, target_lat, target_lon) {
    if (is.null(track) || nrow(track) < 2) {
        return(NA)
    }
    
    # Use last position
    last_lat <- tail(track[, 1], 1)
    last_lon <- tail(track[, 2], 1)
    
    # Bearing to target
    bearing <- calculate_heading(last_lat, last_lon, target_lat, target_lon)
    
    # Current speed (assuming last observation)
    # Estimate from last few points
    if (nrow(track) >= 2) {
        last_dist <- geodist::geodist(
            track[nrow(track)-1, 1], track[nrow(track)-1, 2],
            last_lat, last_lon,
            pairwise = TRUE
        ) * 0.539957
        
        # VMG = speed * cos(heading - bearing)
        vmg <- NA  # Would need current speed
        return(vmg)
    }
    
    return(NA)
}

#' Calculate track efficiency (actual vs direct distance)
#' @param track GPS track
#' @return Efficiency ratio
calculate_track_efficiency <- function(track) {
    if (is.null(track) || nrow(track) < 2) {
        return(NA)
    }
    
    # Actual distance traveled
    actual_dist <- 0
    for (i in 2:nrow(track)) {
        actual_dist <- actual_dist + geodist::geodist(
            track[i-1, 1], track[i-1, 2],
            track[i, 1], track[i, 2],
            pairwise = TRUE
        ) * 0.539957
    }
    
    # Direct distance (start to finish)
    direct_dist <- geodist::geodist(
        track[1, 1], track[1, 2],
        tail(track[, 1], 1), tail(track[, 2], 1),
        pairwise = TRUE
    ) * 0.539957
    
    if (direct_dist < 1) return(NA)
    
    return(direct_dist / actual_dist)
}
```

```{r functions-enrich, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================================
# FUNCTIONS - Data Enrichment and Analysis
# ============================================================================

#' Enrich raw results with boat info and calculated metrics
#' @param results Raw results list
#' @param boat_info Boat info list
#' @return Data frame with all metrics
enrich_results <- function(results, boat_info) {
    result_df <- as.data.frame(results$result)
    result_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(result_df, "boat_id")
    result_df$boat_id <- as.integer(result_df$boat_id)
    
    # Add boat info
    boats_df <- lapply(names(boat_info), function(id) {
        data.frame(
            boat_id = as.integer(id),
            boat_name = boat_info[[id]]$boatName,
            skipper_names = boat_info[[id]]$skipperNames,
            category = boat_info[[id]]$category
        )
    }) %>% do.call(rbind, .)
    
    # Merge
    merged <- merge(result_df, boats_df, by = "boat_id", all.x = TRUE)
    
    # Calculate additional metrics
    merged <- merged %>%
        mutate(
            dtf_dtl_ratio = dtf / (dtl + 0.1),
            speed_rank = rank(-speed),
            distance_rank = rank(-`24hour_distance`)
        )
    
    return(merged)
}

#' Get leaderboard
#' @param df Enriched data frame
#' @param n Number of boats
#' @return Ordered data frame
get_leaderboard <- function(df, n = 15) {
    df %>% arrange(rank) %>% head(n) %>%
        select(boat_id, boat_name, rank, heading, speed, dtf, dtl, category)
}

#' Get category statistics
#' @param df Enriched data frame
#' @return Summary by category
get_category_stats <- function(df) {
    df %>%
        group_by(category) %>%
        summarise(
            n = n(),
            avg_speed = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_speed = max(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_24h = mean(`24hour_distance`, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_24h = max(`24hour_distance`, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_dtf = mean(dtf, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop"
        ) %>% arrange(desc(n))
}

#' Get specific boat analysis
#' @param df Enriched data frame
#' @param boat_name Boat name to find
#' @return Detailed boat data
get_boat_detail <- function(df, boat_name) {
    # Search by name or ID
    boat_name_lower <- tolower(boat_name)
    
    df %>%
        filter(
            tolower(boat_name) == tolower(boat_name) |
            tolower(boat_name) == tolower(boat_name) |
            boat_id == as.integer(boat_name)
        )
}
```

```{r data-loading, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================================
# DATA LOADING
# ============================================================================

data_loaded <- FALSE
results_enriched <- NULL

tryCatch({
    config <- load_config(CONFIG_FILE)
    results <- load_results(RESULTS_FILE)
    boat_info <- load_boat_info(BOATINFO_FILE, config)
    
    # Extract metadata
    metadata <- extract_metadata(config)
    routes <- extract_routes(config)
    
    # Enrich results
    results_enriched <- enrich_results(results, boat_info)
    
    # Run track analysis for each boat
    for (bid in names(results$result)) {
        track_data <- results$result[[bid]]$track
        if (!is.null(track_data) && is.data.frame(track_data)) {
            # Analyze maneuvers
            maneuvers <- analyze_maneuvers(track_data)
            results_enriched$total_maneuvers[results_enriched$boat_id == as.integer(bid)] <- maneuvers$total_maneuvers
            results_enriched$tacks[results_enriched$boat_id == as.integer(bid)] <- maneuvers$tacks
            results_enriched$gybes[results_enriched$boat_id == as.integer(bid)] <- maneuvers$gybes
            
            # Track efficiency
            results_enriched$track_efficiency[results_enriched$boat_id == as.integer(bid)] <- calculate_track_efficiency(track_data)
        }
    }
    
    data_loaded <- TRUE
    
    cat("Data loaded successfully.\n")
    cat("Total boats:", nrow(results_enriched), "\n")
    cat("Categories:", paste(unique(results_enriched$category), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    
}, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error loading data:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
})
```
